children.action: qs ipc call shell toggle transparency

children.title: Floating
children.subtitle: Detached rounded bar
children.action: qs ipc call shell barstyle floating

children.title: Islands

children.action: qs ipc call shell barstyle islands

title: Keybinds
subtitle: Every shortcut, from bindings.lua
action: qs ipc call shell toggle keys

children.action: qs ipc call shell toggle quick

children.title: Do not disturb
children.action: qs ipc call shell toggle dnd

children.title: Night light
children.action: qs ipc call shell toggle nightlight

children.title: Notification history
children.action: qs ipc call shell toggle history

children.title: Bar transparency
children.action: qs ipc call shell toggle transparency

children.title: Check for updates now
children.action: qs ipc call shell refresh updates

children.title: Check keyboard / Compose key
children.action: kitty --class=dot-update --title=dot-update -e bash -c 'dot-restart-xcompose --check; echo; read -rp "Press Enter to close " _'

children.title: Fix wallpaper (create config, add wallpapers)
children.action: kitty --class=dot-update --title=dot-update -e bash -c 'dot-wallpaper init; echo; read -rp "Press Enter to close " _'

children.title: Diagnose problems (dot-doctor)
children.action: kitty --class=dot-update --title=dot-update -e bash -c 'dot-doctor; echo; read -rp "Press Enter to close " _'

children.title: Fans & temperatures (dot-thermal)
children.action: kitty --class=dot-update --title=dot-update -e bash -c 'dot-thermal doctor; echo; read -rp "Press Enter to close " _'

children.title: Fix fans / power policy (dot-thermal setup)
children.action: kitty --class=dot-update --title=dot-update -e bash -c 'dot-thermal setup; echo; read -rp "Press Enter to close " _'

children.title: Battery: limit charge to 80%
children.action: kitty --class=dot-update --title=dot-update -e bash -c 'dot-thermal battery 80; echo; read -rp "Press Enter to close " _'

children.title: Battery: charge to 100% (no limit)
children.action: kitty --class=dot-update --title=dot-update -e bash -c 'dot-thermal battery off; echo; read -rp "Press Enter to close " _'

children.title: Fix dark mode in apps (dot-theme)
children.action: kitty --class=dot-update --title=dot-update -e bash -c 'dot-theme init; echo; dot-theme doctor; echo; read -rp "Press Enter to close " _'
